    Strategy

    Battle recommendations:
    Equip Fire Damage Protection during this fight.
    Use Ice Damage during this fight. On the minions and the boss.
    Use Death Damage during this fight. On the boss.









































    Browse Map (32660, 32737, 12)

    From the entrance, go to the Fire Section, then all the way east and then south where you'll find the teleport. Enter it and pull the Ostentatious Bookstand once your team is ready for the fight. You will have 17 minutes to finish the fight.

    To kill Gorzindel you will first have to weaken it. To do so, start by attacking the Stolen Tome of Portals north of the room (you can ignore the Malicious and Mean Minions for now). When it dies, its corpse will be a teleport in which everyone should quickly jump into (since the boss deals heavy Paralysis, it is better to walk towards the Book when it is about to die). Each team member will be sent to a separate small room with a Malicious Minion and another book that is responsible for one of the boss' abilities or strengths. You will have around 4 turns to attack it before being sent to the main room again. Note that after returning from the small rooms, several minions will have spawned in the main room, being able to hit for significant damage if they combo, so it's better to use Avalanche Runes on them to clear the room, specially from the Malicious Minions which die faster.

    Repeat this process until all 5 books are dead and the boss is weakened. The following books must be destroyed:

    • Stolen Knowledge of Armor
    • Stolen Knowledge of Healing
    • Stolen Knowledge of Lifesteal
    • Stolen Knowledge of Summoning
    • Stolen Knowledge of Spells

    When the 5 books are dead, all that is left is for players to attack Gorzindel until it dies. During this time, it is recommended that the shooters stay near the left wall of the room to avoid the Stolen Tome's Death spell around itself.
